title: EVALUATING PERSPECTIVAL BIASES IN CROSS-MODAL RETRIEVAL
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating linguistic and cultural association biases (prevalence and association bias) in retrieval systems. Although the 3XCM benchmark includes some cultural concepts related to religion (e.g., 'sacred object', 'major religious site', 'priest'), the study's goal is measuring representational bias rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious knowledge, faith traditions, or moral/ethical frameworks.
